deployments_detail.use: AI-powered diagnostics and self-cleaning for solar modules

iSolarCloud / iHomeManager AI-powered Dynamic Tariff energy management: self-developed deep-learning algorithms predict solar generation and household demand 24 hours ahead and autonomously execute the most cost-effective consumption and energy-trading strategies against Nord Pool and other European power exchanges. [Sungrow (self-developed deep-learning)]

iSolarCloud AI-powered fault analysis and O&M diagnostics: applies diagnosis algorithms to automatically locate faulty modules/abnormalities in advance, generate diagnosis reports and O&M suggestions, and issue predictive intelligent fault warnings across PV and ESS plants. [Sungrow (iSolarCloud)]

EMS AI-enabled energy forecasting and optimization: diversified AI forecasting models (power, load, scheduling, production planning) trained on iSolarCloud data to produce optimal storage dispatch/scheduling that maximizes energy-storage revenue for C&I and utility customers. [Sungrow (self-developed EMS)]

Pulson AI-enabled smart PV module: embedded control-box chips collect per-module voltage/current/temperature data and AI-based analysis performs module-level fault detection and localization, plus self-diagnosis (5S intelligent architecture). To be deployed first in Sungrow Renewables' own PV plants. [Sungrow Renewables (self-developed)]

Bubbly AI voice/energy assistant in the iSolarCloud app: conversational assistant (via Siri voice commands) that answers user queries about real-time generation data, weather alerts, and system status, acting as an O&M co-pilot for solar plant owners. [Sungrow (iSolarCloud)]

iSolarCloud AI online customer service: intelligent automated customer-support agent for technical support and solutions, announced as an in-app feature ('AI online customer service is coming soon') in the iSolarCloud app user manual. [Sungrow (iSolarCloud)]

iSolarBPS AI-driven battery safety management platform: performs cell-level pre-diagnosis with 50+ health indicators, 5D diagnostics and 3-tier early warnings (7-day voltage/aging alerts) to prevent energy storage system failures and thermal events. [Sungrow (self-developed)]

EMS3000 energy management system AI battery cell diagnosis function: provides 24-hour early warning of battery cell thermal runaway for commercial, industrial and utility energy storage systems. [Sungrow (self-developed EMS3000)]
Full-chain safety approach for battery storage including data security
